title: Cubic Bottles
body:
### Do you ever wanted to refresh the bottles texture? Here is a RP that makes them cubic! Looks kinda vanilla, isnt it?
There is also a version that supports [TEAP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack)! [Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cb+teap) it is.

Please join my [telegram channel](https://t.me/erisigma42SUPERPUPERMINECRAFT) to see more swag things from me!
